{{Top|leg}}
'''Adari's personal memoirs''' were found by [[Quarra Thayn]] in [[Library of Adari Vaal|Adari Vaal's secret library]] on the [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] continent known as [[Alanciar]]. They described [[Adari Vaal]]'s mother, [[Eulyn]]; very little information about Adari's [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] to [[Zhari Vaal]]; Adari's regrets over leaving her sons [[Finn Vaal|Finn]] and [[Tona Vaal|Tona]] behind on [[Keshtah Minor]]; information about [[Yaru Korsin]]'s [[Duel near the Omen#Aftermath|first encounter]] with the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]], and using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to reach Adari's mind; and later Korsin's [[Seelah Korsin|wife's]] disdain for her.
